description: This file defines the LiveActivityManager class responsible for managing live activity sessions, interface with ActivityKit, and handling state transitions such as connecting, idle, and disconnected within an iOS application.

classes.name: LiveActivityManager
classes.description: A singleton class managing the lifecycle of live activities, including starting, updating, and ending activities, and ensuring proper cleanup and state management.

methods.name: startActivity
methods.description: Starts a new live activity with specified agent name and session key, or handles if an activity is already running.

methods.name: handleConnecting
methods.description: Handles transition to the connecting state.

methods.name: handleReconnect
methods.description: Handles transition to the idle state.

methods.name: handleDisconnect
methods.description: Handles transition to the disconnected state.

methods.name: hydrateCurrentAndPruneDuplicates
methods.description: Initializes current activity from existing activities and ends any duplicate/stale activities.
